dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Progressive, symmetrical 2D narrowing of the lateral margins from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Subtle asymmetrical undulations on the right lateral margin; the left margin exhibits a more uniform, convex curvature.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with a very light grey median pixel intensity.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse grey shading localized primarily on the anterior and mid-dorsal sections.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; gradual tonal shifts between shaded regions and the white baseline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A distinct transverse crease or shallow topological indentation visible in the anterior dorsal region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A faint, longitudinal linear marking visible along the midline of the posterior dorsal surface.
